PlainEnglishBasis: The award covers employers in road transport and distribution industry
TriggerCondition: ORG003=Transport-Logistics OR ORG004 contains transport keywords
LogicSummary: If industry confirmed as transport then RTD/RTLDO branch applies
ExceptionHandling: If industry is ambiguous flag for manual review
AuditNoteGuidance: Record basis of industry determination
CommonMistakes: Assuming transport coverage for incidental delivery operations by non-transport employers
ManualReviewTrigger: Employer in logistics/warehousing only without vehicle operations
ValidationRequired: Yes — verify coverage clause in MA000038

PlainEnglishBasis: RTLDO covers employees engaged in long distance operations involving overnight stays
LogicSummary: If long distance confirmed then RTLDO award applies
ExceptionHandling: If boundary unclear flag for manual review
AuditNoteGuidance: Record trip pattern evidence used for determination
CommonMistakes: Assuming any interstate trip qualifies without checking overnight requirement
ManualReviewTrigger: Employee performs both local and long-distance runs
ValidationRequired: Yes — verify RTLDO definition in MA000039

PlainEnglishBasis: RTD covers drivers warehouse dispatch and related employees in transport industry
LogicSummary: If RTD industry and transport duties confirmed then MA000038 applies
ExceptionHandling: If duties are primarily clerical proceed to ACE-04
AuditNoteGuidance: Record duty description used for determination
CommonMistakes: Applying RTD to clerical employees in transport companies
ManualReviewTrigger: Duty split between transport and clerical
ConfidenceStatus: High for primary transport duties — lower for mixed
ValidationRequired: Yes — verify coverage clause

ClauseReference: General award coverage law — principal purpose test
PlainEnglishBasis: Where employee has mixed duties the principal purpose of engagement determines which award applies
LogicSummary: If transport primary apply MA000038; if clerical primary apply MA000002; if equal flag for review
ExceptionHandling: Mixed duties cannot be automated — always flag when close to 50/50
AuditNoteGuidance: Record time allocation evidence; document basis for principal purpose determination
CommonMistakes: Relying solely on job title to resolve mixed duties
ManualReviewTrigger: Always trigger manual review when duties are 40-60 each category
ValidationRequired: Yes — verify principal purpose test application

PlainEnglishBasis: Clerks Award covers private sector clerical and administrative employees
LogicSummary: If clerical duties and private sector confirmed then MA000002 applies
ExceptionHandling: If public sector or more specific industry award applies then stop
AuditNoteGuidance: Record basis of coverage determination
CommonMistakes: Applying Clerks Award to government or not-for-profit employees
ManualReviewTrigger: Employer in specific industry with its own award
ConfidenceStatus: High for clearly clerical private sector — lower for industry-specific employers
ValidationRequired: Yes — verify Clerks Award coverage clause

PlainEnglishBasis: Award covers private sector employees in classifications in Schedule A
TriggerCondition: ETP001 confirmed + ORG005=Private + duties in Schedule A classifications
LogicSummary: Apply if all conditions met
ExceptionHandling: Flag if sector is not private
AuditNoteGuidance: Record that Schedule A coverage has been confirmed
CommonMistakes: Applying to not-for-profit community sector workers
ManualReviewTrigger: Employer in industry with its own award covering clerical functions
ValidationRequired: Yes — verify coverage clause and Schedule A

PlainEnglishBasis: Classification based on duties skills level of supervision and responsibility
LogicSummary: Match role duties to award Schedule A level descriptors starting from Level 1 upward
ExceptionHandling: If role spans two levels apply higher level as risk mitigation
AuditNoteGuidance: Record assessment questions answered and classification evidence reference
CommonMistakes: Using contract title or employer preference rather than actual duties
ManualReviewTrigger: Role genuinely spans two classification levels
ConfidenceStatus: High if properly assessed — Low if based on title only
ValidationRequired: Yes — verify Schedule A level descriptors and indicators

PlainEnglishBasis: Full-time employee works 38 ordinary hours per week
LogicSummary: Ordinary hours = 38 per week; daily = 7.6 (5-day week); no casual loading
ExceptionHandling: If contracted hours differ from 38 flag for review
AuditNoteGuidance: Record employment type basis in audit output
CommonMistakes: Treating employees with 38+ hour contracts as exempt from overtime
ManualReviewTrigger: Contracted hours significantly different from 38
ValidationRequired: No

PlainEnglishBasis: Part-time employee has guaranteed hours set in writing; additional hours may be OT
LogicSummary: Ordinary hours = ETP004; hours above guarantee — verify whether OT or additional ordinary
ExceptionHandling: If guaranteed hours not documented flag for review
AuditNoteGuidance: Record guaranteed hours source document
CommonMistakes: Not documenting guaranteed hours in writing; not assessing whether additional hours are OT
ManualReviewTrigger: Guaranteed hours not in writing; regular hours exceed agreement
ConfidenceStatus: High for ordinary hours — Medium for additional hours OT treatment
ValidationRequired: Yes — verify part-time provisions including additional hours treatment

PlainEnglishBasis: Casual employees receive loading on top of ordinary rate for each engagement
LogicSummary: Casual rate = base_rate × (1 + casual_loading_pct); validate 25% from award
ExceptionHandling: If minimum engagement not met apply minimum
AuditNoteGuidance: Record casual engagement basis; note loading percentage used
CommonMistakes: Applying casual loading without verifying percentage from award; not applying minimum engagement
ManualReviewTrigger: Casual engaged for period below minimum engagement
ValidationRequired: Yes — verify casual loading percentage and minimum engagement from MA000002

PlainEnglishBasis: Ordinary time applies within the award span of hours; hours outside span attract penalties
LogicSummary: Identify hours within span (ordinary rate) and outside span (penalty rate)
ExceptionHandling: If span times uncertain flag for review
AuditNoteGuidance: Record span classification for each shift in audit output
CommonMistakes: Not splitting hours at span boundary; treating all weekday hours as ordinary
ManualReviewTrigger: Shift substantially outside span of ordinary hours
ConfidenceStatus: High for concept — verify exact span times
ValidationRequired: Yes — verify exact span start and end times in MA000002

PlainEnglishBasis: Hours worked beyond ordinary daily hours attract overtime rates
LogicSummary: daily_OT = SHF008 minus daily_ordinary; Tier1 = MIN(OT 2hrs) × 1.5×; Tier2 = remainder × 2.0×
ExceptionHandling: Ensure no double count with weekly OT
AuditNoteGuidance: Record daily overtime hours and rate tiers applied
CommonMistakes: Not applying correct two-tier overtime structure; double-counting daily and weekly OT
ManualReviewTrigger: Uncertain about OT trigger for part-time employees
ConfidenceStatus: High for full-time — verify trigger for PT
ValidationRequired: Yes — verify daily OT trigger and tier multipliers from MA000002

PlainEnglishBasis: Hours worked beyond 38 in a week attract overtime rates
LogicSummary: weekly_OT = total_hours minus 38; avoid double count with daily OT
ExceptionHandling: Confirm no double-counting
AuditNoteGuidance: Record weekly hours total and OT identified
CommonMistakes: Paying daily OT then also paying the same hours as weekly OT
ManualReviewTrigger: Regular weekly hours consistently exceed 38
ValidationRequired: No — confirm multipliers from award

ClauseReference: MA000002 penalty clauses — verify all rates
PlainEnglishBasis: Penalty rates apply for work outside ordinary span and on weekends and public holidays
TriggerCondition: Day type and time of day
LogicSummary: Apply correct multiplier from Rates_Table for each hour type
ExceptionHandling: If penalty type unclear flag for review
AuditNoteGuidance: Record which penalty codes were applied in audit output
CommonMistakes: Hard-coding penalty percentages; not updating multipliers after Annual Wage Review
ManualReviewTrigger: Multiple penalties applying to same hours simultaneously
ConfidenceStatus: High for concept — verify all multipliers from award
ValidationRequired: Yes — verify every multiplier from MA000002 and FWO pay guide

PlainEnglishBasis: Employees entitled to day off with pay on public holiday; PH work attracts higher rate
TriggerCondition: SHF002 is a public holiday date in PH_Table
LogicSummary: If PH and worked: apply PH rate; if PH and not worked: pay ordinary day's pay
ExceptionHandling: If substitute day applies check PH_Table for substitute
AuditNoteGuidance: Record PH date name and state; record whether employee worked
CommonMistakes: Applying weekday rate on a public holiday; not paying for PH not worked
ManualReviewTrigger: Substitute day scenarios; employee only works part of a PH
ValidationRequired: No — standard NES entitlement

PlainEnglishBasis: RTD Award covers employers in road transport and distribution industry
LogicSummary: Industry test satisfied if transport/distribution confirmed
ExceptionHandling: If incidental transport by non-transport employer flag for review
AuditNoteGuidance: Record industry basis in audit
CommonMistakes: Applying RTD to employers where transport is incidental not primary activity
ManualReviewTrigger: Logistics/warehousing-only without delivery operations
ValidationRequired: Yes — verify coverage clause in MA000038

PlainEnglishBasis: Classification based primarily on GVM of vehicle operated plus duties
LogicSummary: Match GVM to classification grade; check for leading hand or forklift modifiers
ExceptionHandling: If GVM vs classification mismatch flag ESC-14
AuditNoteGuidance: Record GVM source (fleet register); record classification evidence
CommonMistakes: Using job title alone; not checking GVM against fleet register
ManualReviewTrigger: Employee drives multiple vehicle types regularly
ConfidenceStatus: High for GVM-based grades — verify GVM thresholds
ValidationRequired: Yes — verify Schedule A GVM thresholds and grade titles from MA000038

PlainEnglishBasis: Hours beyond ordinary daily limit attract overtime rates
LogicSummary: Tier1 OT = first 2 hours × 1.5× (verify); Tier2 = remainder × 2.0× (verify)
ExceptionHandling: No double-count with weekly OT
AuditNoteGuidance: Record OT hours and tier in audit
CommonMistakes: Using wrong daily ordinary limit
ManualReviewTrigger: Uncertain about daily ordinary limit under RTD
ValidationRequired: Yes — verify daily ordinary limit in MA000038

PlainEnglishBasis: Drivers entitled to vehicle allowance based on vehicle class
LogicSummary: Lookup vehicle allowance from Allowances_Table by GVM class
ExceptionHandling: If GVM class not in table flag for review
AuditNoteGuidance: Record allowance code and amount applied
CommonMistakes: Not applying vehicle allowance; applying wrong GVM class
ManualReviewTrigger: Multiple vehicle types operated
ValidationRequired: Yes — verify all vehicle allowance amounts from MA000038 and FWO pay guide

PlainEnglishBasis: Additional allowance for handling dangerous goods
LogicSummary: Apply DG allowance from Allowances_Table
ExceptionHandling: If DG licence not confirmed do not apply
AuditNoteGuidance: Record DG licence confirmation
CommonMistakes: Claiming DG allowance without confirming DG licence and actual DG handling
ManualReviewTrigger: Occasional DG handling vs regular
ValidationRequired: Yes — verify DG allowance trigger and amount from MA000038

PlainEnglishBasis: Long distance drivers paid a per-kilometre rate with minimum weekly floor
LogicSummary: per_km_pay = LDT003 × lookup rate; compare to minimum weekly floor; apply MAX
ExceptionHandling: If per-km rate not in Rates_Table flag for review
AuditNoteGuidance: Record km total and rate category applied; note if minimum floor was triggered
CommonMistakes: Applying hourly rate model to RTLDO employee; not checking minimum floor
ManualReviewTrigger: Very low km week where minimum floor applies
ConfidenceStatus: Moderate — concept well established; details require validation
ValidationRequired: Yes — verify per-km rates minimum weekly floor and all RTLDO rate details from MA000039

PlainEnglishBasis: Payment for waiting time at destination beyond trigger threshold
LogicSummary: Waiting time pay = (LDT004 minus trigger) × waiting_time_rate
ExceptionHandling: If waiting time cause is force majeure check award treatment
AuditNoteGuidance: Record waiting hours and trigger applied
CommonMistakes: Not paying waiting time; applying full rate for all waiting hours including below trigger
ManualReviewTrigger: Force majeure events causing extended waits
ValidationRequired: Yes — verify trigger hours and waiting time rate from MA000039

PlainEnglishBasis: Overnight allowance payable when driver stays away from base and employer does not provide accommodation
LogicSummary: nights_away × accommodation_rate
ExceptionHandling: If employer provides accommodation confirm allowance still applies or reduces
AuditNoteGuidance: Record number of nights and accommodation arrangement
CommonMistakes: Not paying accommodation allowance; paying when employer provided accommodation
ManualReviewTrigger: Employer provides shared or substandard accommodation — does allowance reduce?
ValidationRequired: Yes — verify accommodation allowance amount and conditions from MA000039

PlainEnglishBasis: Heavy vehicles must comply with HVNL fatigue management requirements separately from award
LogicSummary: Always display HVNL warning for RTLDO employees
ExceptionHandling: N/A — outside tool scope
AuditNoteGuidance: Record HVNL warning was displayed in audit output
CommonMistakes: Assuming award compliance equals HVNL compliance
ManualReviewTrigger: Always triggers for RTLDO employees
ConfidenceStatus: High — this is a mandatory warning
ValidationRequired: No — HVNL is separately applicable legislation outside this tool's scope
